messages:
ellie_oncall: incoming alert — 90th p99 latency spike on prod-cluster-3 starting ~1760823000, throughput dropped ~30% :grimacing:
max_runtime: saw the same in profiler traces, KV cache miss rate jumped. looks like an eviction storm after the last runtime rollout.
rachel_obs: dashboards show missing traces for a subset of requests during the window (sampling rate down to 1%). logs are sparse.
ajay_infra: any noisy neighbor on the node? node metrics show GPU saturation on host-7 around the same time. could be co-tenancy burst.
max_runtime: interesting — kernel selector logged a fallback to the generic kernel for some shards. snippet from runtime logs:
```
[1760823021] kernel_select: model=redwood-x-3b quantized=true preferred_kernel=fast_qk fallback=generic_kv_unopt
[1760823021] kv_cache: miss_ratio=0.39 eviction_rate=0.12 reason=kv_eviction_storm
```
ellie_oncall: that fallback would explain latency. but why kv eviction spike? no recent config change from our side.
max_runtime: we flipped batching heuristics last week (auto-batcher v2) — it increases max batch horizon. hypothesis: larger batches caused warm-KV churn and more memory pressure + eviction.
rachel_obs: also noticed our trace sampler was set to 1% for prod-cluster-3 to control storage costs. during incidents that hides the tail behavior. dashboard panels show request_count but not batch composition, so we missed the correlation.
ajay_infra: deploy-bot shows a routing change at 1760822004 — can we correlate?
deploy-bot: Deploy event: runtime/autoscaler v2 -> canary on prod-cluster-3 at 1760822004 by max_runtime. status: successful.
max_runtime: ok that matches. we probably need to rollback the batching heuristic or tighten KV cache limits.
ellie_oncall: quick mitigations: 1) increase trace sampling to 10% for the cluster, 2) temporarily pin runtime to previous canary (rollback), 3) bump KV cache limit if safe. who can do steps?
ajay_infra: I can raise trace sampling and bump cache limit on the fleet in 2 mins.
rachel_obs: I'll flip sampling and add a high-cardinality dashboard tile for batch_size distribution and kernel selection counts.
max_runtime: I'll prepare a rollback patch and a narrow fix: cap batch horizon per-model and add aggressive prefetch for KV to reduce miss storm.
ellie_oncall: also add an alert if kernel_fallback_rate > 0.05 over 1m — we lacked that. created a ticket: https://tickets.redwood/INC-6589
rachel_obs: note: log sampling config was set at the app level, not runtime — that's why some runtime logs didn't appear in traces. we should centralize sampling so incident telemetry stays intact.
max_runtime: attaching quick profiler command to reproduce locally:
```
./profiler --cluster prod-cluster-3 --since 1760823000 --filter kernel=generic_kv_unopt --output short
```
ellie_oncall: good. after mitigation we'll run a postmortem focusing on: kernel selector telemetry gaps, batching heuristic rollout strategy, and trace/log sampling alignment.
ajay_infra: mitigation done: sampling -> 10% (1760823620), KV_cache_limit +15% (1760823640), rollback canary started (1760823680).
deploy-bot: Rollback event: runtime/autoscaler v2 -> rollback initiated at 1760823680 by max_runtime.
ellie_oncall: latency trending back down, throughput recovering. keep monitoring for 30m. :thumbsup:
rachel_obs: created dashboard tile: `batch_size_hist` and `kernel_fallback_rate` and pinned to incidents channel.
max_runtime: follow-up actions: add kernel_fallback_count to per-route traces, increase default trace sampling in incidents mode, and add test for eviction scenarios in the CI perf harness.
ellie_oncall: thanks team — we'll draft a short blameless postmortem once we confirm root cause.
sre_tooling_bot: Incident INC-6589 labeled: perf-regression + observability-gap. SLA breach window: 1760823000-1760823720.
